subject: SummitCloud procurement: billing path & MAP workback for private offers
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@summitcloud.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SummitCloud procurement: billing path & MAP workback for private offers

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a concise workback and mutual action plan (MAP) that covers the evaluation window, acceptance criteria, and the billing/procurement path for private offers across AWS/GCP/Azure. Key highlights at a glance:

- Recommended path: AWS Private Offer for initial pilot (fastest invoice/PO flow) with a parallel Azure marketplace plan if you prefer multi-cloud billing later.
- Evaluation: 6–8 week pilot (we recommend a focused 4-week acceptance window within that for feature validation and scaling tests).
- Procurement steps: security attestation (SOC2 evidence), legal terms, PO issuance, and finance routing (we can invoice monthly against PO).

I attached a one-page MAP (PDF) and a term-sheet draft for the AWS private offer with the billing contact fields populated. Please review and share any procurement constraints (vendor codes, net terms, or required PO language).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Procurement kickoff call (45 mins) — propose Wed 6/5 or Thu 6/6.
2) Finalize MAP acceptance criteria and sign-off owners.
3) If AWS path accepted, we’ll open the private-offer request and share a DocuSign/PO-friendly term sheet for your legal team.

If helpful, Karthik and Logan are on this thread to cover partner & billing details.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0121

Attachment: 20280603-SummitCloud-MAP-draft.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: summitcloud-aws-private-offer-term-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Asha Menon <asha@summitcloud.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@summitcloud.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Jun 2028 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitCloud procurement: billing path & MAP workback for private offers

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the clear MAP. A few quick notes from procurement and finance:

- We prefer AWS private offer for pilot billing, agree that’s the fastest route.
- Our standard is Net45; can Redwood accept Net30 or Net45?
- We require the following invoice fields: SummitCloud vendor code (SC-2991), PO number on invoice, and a billing contact name/email.
- For security, please include the SOC2 Type II report and the data retention table in the next email so we can circulate to our infosec team.

We can do the procurement kickoff on Thu 6/6 at 10:00 PT. I’ll invite our legal and finance leads.

Thanks — will loop in procurement formally.
Asha
Asha Menon
Head of Platform Engineering, SummitCloud
asha@summitcloud.ai

Date: Tue, 04 Jun 2028 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitCloud procurement: billing path & MAP workback for private offers

Thanks Asha — quick answers from our side:

- Billing terms: we can accept Net30 by default for pilots; Net45 will need sign-off from RevOps (I can escalate if Net45 is mandatory).
- Invoice fields: we will populate vendor code/PO on the invoice and can set billing contact as accounting@summitcloud.ai if that’s the preferred mailbox.
- Security artifacts: attaching SOC2 summary and a short data-retention matrix here for your infosec.

Note on Azure: Azure private offers sometimes require MS resellers for certain pricing flows; if you think Azure is a must for procurement, let us know and we’ll prepare an alternate flow. For the fastest time to invoice, AWS private offer is still generally smoother.

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: data-retention-matrix.csv (text/csv)

Karthik
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement <procurement@summitcloud.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha@summitcloud.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Jun 2028 10:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SummitCloud procurement: billing path & MAP workback for private offers

Thanks for the attachments. A few procurement items to close before PO:

1) Please confirm Redwood legal entity and W-9 or equivalent.
2) Confirm acceptance of Net45 (preferred) vs Net30. If Redwood needs Net30, provide an AR contact for expedited processing.
3) Please add the following contract clause for data residency: "Customer data will be stored and processed in US regions unless otherwise agreed in writing."
4) We require a sample invoice PDF with vendor code and PO sample as proof-of-format.

We’ll review and, barring any unexpected flag, will issue a PO within 5 business days of these items being confirmed.

Procurement Team
SummitCloud
procurement@summitcloud.ai

Hi procurement team —

Thanks for the list. Quick follow-up and confirmations to unblock the PO:

1) Redwood legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. — FEIN: XX-XXXXXXX. W-9 attached in this thread (pdf).
2) Billing terms: we can accept Net45 for this pilot. Confirmed.
3) Data residency clause: happy to include the proposed sentence. We’ll add the data residency line to the private-offer term-sheet as requested.
4) Sample invoice: attached (sample-invoice-summit.pdf) — includes PO placeholder and vendor code SC-2991.

Operational notes for the MAP workback:
- Pilot start: target 2028-06-20 (once PO issued and AWS private-offer accepted).
- Evaluation window: 6 weeks (6/20–7/31). Acceptance gate at week 4 for performance & integration tests.
- Redwood responsibilities: provisioning test instances, 24/7 support during the first 72 hours of rollout, weekly check-ins.
- SummitCloud responsibilities: test plan sign-off, provide test datasets, and timely PO issuance.

Attachments: W-9-Redwood-Inference.pdf (application/pdf), sample-invoice-summit.pdf (application/pdf)

If that aligns, we’ll prepare the private-offer request to AWS and share the DocuSign-ready term sheet for legal to sign.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Soojin
